name: Predge-gated allocation
description: Move value only when a Predge-signed conviction signal clears the gate. The signal is fetched and its ed25519 signature is verified before this workflow is allowed to run; the workflow itself is the deterministic, audited execution KeeperHub owns.

trigger.note: Fired by the Predge integration only after offline signature verification passes. The verified conviction (0-100) and action are passed in as inputs.

nodes.note: Preflight — estimates gas and catches reverts without touching the chain.
The exact same movement, executed. Nonce, gas, MEV-aware routing, retries and audit trail are KeeperHub's.
